text.zh: 就读离家四英里的单间教室乡村小学（Arncliffe School）。
text.en: Goes to a one-room village school four miles from home, Arncliffe School.

text.zh: 农家之子；他说村里除了他还在襁褓中的弟弟，就只有他一个小孩。
text.en: A farmer's son; he says he is the only child in his village apart from his baby brother.

text.zh: 住在约克郡山谷 Arncliffe 村的一个小农场。
text.en: Lives in the Yorkshire Dales, on a small farm in the village of Arncliffe.

text.zh: 加入本系列；影片首播时他只有 6 岁。
text.en: Joins the series; he was only 6 when the film was first broadcast.

text.zh: 获奖学金进入约克郡一所寄宿学校，在校寄宿。
text.en: Won a scholarship to a Yorkshire boarding school, where he boards.

text.zh: 父亲务农；他最小的弟弟是聋人。
text.en: His father farms; his youngest brother is deaf.

text.zh: 在约克郡山谷的家庭农场和寄宿学校两地生活。
text.en: Lives between the family farm in the Yorkshire Dales and his boarding school.

text.zh: 自上一部影片以来，他获奖学金进入约克郡一所寄宿学校。
text.en: Since the first film he has won a scholarship to a Yorkshire boarding school.

text.zh: 对务农毫无兴趣；他说自己喜欢物理和化学，而在农场做不了这些。
text.en: Not interested in farming; he says he is interested in physics and chemistry, which he cannot pursue there.

text.zh: 在牛津大学 Merton College 读物理，正读大二。
text.en: In his second year reading physics at Merton College, Oxford.

text.zh: 仍是学生；他说如果自己够格，希望从事科研。
text.en: Still a student; he would like to go into research if he proves good enough.

text.zh: 作为学生在牛津大学 Merton College 求学。
text.en: At Oxford University, at Merton College, as a student.

text.zh: 已从寄宿学校升入牛津大学读物理。
text.en: Has moved on from boarding school to Oxford University to read physics.

text.zh: 不接受“最成功的人”之说，认为自己还没做成什么特别的事；也在刻意克服害羞。
text.en: Rejects being called the big success, saying he has done nothing very special yet; he has consciously worked at being less shy.

text.zh: 读完物理学位后用两年半拿到博士；1981 年获牛津大学工程科学博士。
text.en: Finished a physics degree, then a PhD in two and a half years; Oxford awarded his PhD in engineering science in 1981.

text.zh: 威斯康星大学助理教授，核物理学家，从事核聚变研究，年薪 3 万美元。
text.en: Assistant professor at the University of Wisconsin, a nuclear physicist doing fusion research, earning $30,000 a year.

text.zh: 与 Jackie 结婚四年，两人是在牛津读书时相识的；正考虑如何兼顾孩子与两份事业。
text.en: Married four years to Jackie, whom he met when both were Oxford students; they are weighing children against two careers.

text.zh: 1982 年 11 月移居美国，在威斯康星大学工作。
text.en: Lives in America, having moved there in November 1982 to work at the University of Wisconsin.

text.zh: 博士毕业后在英国原子能管理局的核聚变实验室工作，1982 年 11 月移居美国。
text.en: After his PhD he worked at the UK Atomic Energy Authority's fusion laboratory, then emigrated to America in November 1982.

text.zh: 他不觉得自己辜负了英国：英国把他培养得很好，却对他受训要做的工作毫无兴趣。
text.en: He doesn't feel he let England down: it trained him superbly, then showed no interest in the work he was trained for.

text.zh: 威斯康星大学副教授，一心推进研究，同时培养学生。
text.en: Associate professor at the University of Wisconsin, ambitious to push his research forward and to train his students.

text.zh: 与 Jackie 仍是夫妻；有一个一岁的儿子 Adam，两人决定不让他上镜。
text.en: Married to Jackie; they have a one-year-old son, Adam, whom they have decided to keep out of the film.

text.zh: 住在 Madison，他说那是个很友好的小社区，常有鹿出没。
text.en: Lives in Madison, which he calls a very friendly small community with deer running through.

text.zh: 儿子 Adam 出生；他已是副教授；Jackie 不满此前的呈现方式，此后不再出镜。
text.en: Son Adam was born; he is now an associate professor; Jackie no longer appears, having disliked how she was portrayed.

text.zh: 他觉得自己从七岁起走了很远，但很多性格仍没变，依旧容易难为情。
text.en: He feels he has come an awful long way since seven, yet much of the same personality remains, still easily embarrassed.

text.zh: 威斯康星大学电气工程系正教授兼副系主任，主管研究生项目；近一年半写了两本书。
text.en: Full professor and associate chair of Electrical Engineering at Wisconsin, running its graduate programme; has spent 18 months writing two books.

text.zh: 与在同校任新闻学教授的 Jackie 结婚；育有一个八岁的儿子。
text.en: Married to Jackie, a professor of journalism at the university; they have one son, aged eight.

text.zh: 仍住在美国；今年回约克郡山谷探亲，距上次回乡已有五年。
text.en: Still lives in America; this year he went back to the Dales, his first visit in five years.

text.zh: 父亲腿疾缠身，即将退休，农场牲畜已卖掉；他已升为正教授。
text.en: His father, plagued by leg trouble, is retiring and the farm's stock has been sold; he is now a full professor.

text.zh: 他以身为约克郡山谷人为荣，远离故土让他非常难受，但还看不到回去的办法。
text.en: Proud to be a Dales person, he finds being away from his roots terribly hard but sees no way back yet.

text.zh: 教本科生，他说教书的冲动一直都在；他已被迫放弃核聚变研究。
text.en: Teaches undergraduates, a compulsion he says was always in him; he has had to abandon his fusion research.

text.zh: 六年前与 Jackie 离婚，儿子 Adam 时年 10 岁；现娶 Cryss 为妻。
text.en: Divorced from Jackie six years ago, when son Adam was 10; now married to Cryss.

text.zh: 他住 Madison，妻子住五小时车程外的 Minneapolis，隔周末往返。
text.en: Lives in Madison; his wife Cryss lives in Minneapolis, five hours' drive away, and they alternate weekends.

text.zh: 与 Jackie 离婚；核聚变研究受挫后被迫放弃；再婚。
text.en: Divorced Jackie, abandoned his troubled fusion research and remarried.

text.zh: 他一直想念英国，说自己本就不是该远走他乡的那种人。
text.en: He always misses England and says he was never the sort of person who should have moved very far.

text.zh: UW–Madison 电气工程教授；他说核聚变在有生之年不会实现，只好另找方向。
text.en: Professor of Electrical Engineering at UW–Madison; he says fusion won't come in his lifetime, so he had to find something else.

text.zh: 与“新妻子”Cryss 结婚；父母离婚时儿子 Adam 10 岁。
text.en: Married to Cryss, his 'new wife'; his son Adam was 10 when his parents divorced.

text.zh: 仍在美国 UW–Madison；很少回英国探望家人。
text.en: Still in America at UW–Madison; trips back to England to see family are rare.

text.zh: 与 Suzy 一起受访，两人因同样的乡村出身而成为朋友。
text.en: Interviewed jointly with Suzy, having become friends through their shared rural upbringing.

text.zh: 他说若在英国有大学职位，他会“毫不犹豫”地留下，但英国似乎并不需要他这样的人。
text.en: He says he would have stayed in England 'in a heartbeat' for a university job, but England didn't seem to want people like him.

text.zh: 仍在 UW–Madison 任教授、教书；他说学生们很棒，会尽量坚持带下去。
text.en: Still teaching as a professor at UW–Madison; he calls his students wonderful and is hanging in with them as long as he can.

text.zh: 与 Cryss 结婚，他说妻子在他患病期间简直是天使；儿子 Adam。
text.en: Married to Cryss, who he says has been a complete angel about his illness; son Adam.

text.zh: 仍在美国 UW–Madison。
text.en: Still in the US, at UW–Madison.

text.zh: 他身患喉癌、病情严重；父亲已去世，终年八十五岁左右。
text.en: He is seriously ill with throat cancer, and his father has died in his mid-80s.

text.zh: 他说最伤心的是自己患病及其对身边人的影响；他不为自己害怕，而为他们担心。
text.en: His saddest thing is his illness and its effect on those around him; he fears not for himself but for them.

text.zh: 2022 年春从 UW–Madison 教授职位退休，他自 1982 年起在该校任教。
text.en: Retired in spring 2022 from his UW–Madison professorship, held since 1982.

text.zh: 与 Cryss 结婚；身后留下妻子和儿子 Adam。
text.en: Married to Cryss; he was survived by her and his son Adam.

text.zh: 住在美国威斯康星州。
text.en: Lived in Wisconsin, US.

text.zh: 前一年秋天中风；录完最后一次访谈三天后，于 2023 年 7 月 23 日因喉癌去世。
text.en: After a stroke the previous autumn, he recorded a final interview and died of throat cancer on 23 July 2023, three days later.
A retired professor of electrical and computer engineering in Wisconsin, married with one son. He died of throat cancer on 23 July 2023, aged 65, shortly after recording a final interview.
text.zh: 退休前是美国威斯康星州的电气与计算机工程教授，已婚，有一个儿子。2023 年 7 月 23 日因喉癌去世，终年 65 岁，去世前不久刚录完最后一次访谈。
